stack: WinUI 3 (Windows App SDK 1.7) + CommunityToolkit DataGrid 7.1.2 + CommunityToolkit.Mvvm 8.4, C#/XAML

bad_guidance.why: Selected as a core 'what to build' component on the lexical hit 'checklist' (0.408) in a diagnose-only audit; the checklist in the sentence is the review instrument, not UI.
No imagery on the page; a core slot spent on a record with no bearing on an accessibility review.

misses.what: components=['list'], screen=[], primary_jobs=['accessibility list'], preserve=[] for a read-only review of a DataGrid page
a11y.color_not_only, a11y.live_status, a11y.text_scaling demanded only as recommended in an accessibility audit
a11y-color-not-only, a11y-live-status, a11y-text-scaling and grid-single-tab-stop had candidates and were dropped; comp-setup-checklist took a core slot

radius UNKNOWN and corner_language=sharp despite OverlayCornerRadius/ControlCornerRadius; typography UNKNOWN and tabular_numerals=false despite Typography.NumeralAlignment=Tabular; focus slot never read from UseSystemFocusVisuals so direction marks it new

WinUI UIA mechanics: LiveSetting needs RaiseAutomationEvent(LiveRegionChanged); InfoBar announces only on closed->open; Panels have no automation peer; Toolkit DataGrid header/cell names only from string Header / direct TextBlock / ClipboardContentBinding; fixed RowHeight vs text scaling 225%

knowledge_gaps: XAML live regions: AutomationProperties.LiveSetting alone is silent; the app must raise AutomationEvents.LiveRegionChanged after the text changes (no record carries this; a11y-live-status has no WinUI note)
WinUI InfoBar raises its AT notification only on the closed-to-open transition; a one-way IsOpen binding to a boolean must be toggled

StackPanel/Grid/Border have no automation peer: AutomationProperties.Name on them is not the cell's name; Toolkit DataGridCellAutomationPeer names template cells only via direct TextBlock/TextBox or ClipboardContentBinding
Toolkit DataGridColumnHeaderAutomationPeer names the header only when Header is a string; an element Header has no UIA name
Windows text scaling (100-225%) vs fixed RowHeight/ColumnHeaderHeight/Width in WinUI grids and filter rows (a11y-text-scaling exists but has no WinUI note)
Toolkit DataGrid TabNavigation=Once + read-only ProcessTabKey: buttons inside template cells are keyboard-unreachable; grid-single-tab-stop knows this but was not selected

regressions.expect: diagnose-only audit selects no lexical 'what to build' core component; comp-setup-checklist absent

regressions.query: any accessibility-mode audit on desktop or web
regressions.expect: a11y.color_not_only, a11y.live_status, a11y.text_scaling are required concepts and covered by a11y-color-not-only / a11y-live-status / a11y-text-scaling

regressions.query: accessibility review of a WinUI page with a DataGrid and per-row buttons
regressions.expect: grid-single-tab-stop (or comp-data-table) selected for interaction.keyboard_navigation ahead of the generic a11y-keyboard-operable

regressions.query: inspect a WinUI project using OverlayCornerRadius/ControlCornerRadius and Typography.NumeralAlignment=Tabular
regressions.expect: radius KNOWN, typography KNOWN (system styles), tabular_numerals true, corner_language not sharp

regressions.query: direction, low budget, repo with UseSystemFocusVisuals=True
regressions.expect: focus slot preserved (system focus visuals), not new

regressions.query: search 'WinUI live region LiveSetting announce status change'
regressions.expect: a11y-live-status carries a WinUI note about RaiseAutomationEvent(LiveRegionChanged) and InfoBar open-only announcement
